vb_textbox.text: Put your fingers on both S and K so you can sure to select a gnome. Also be ready to hit the space bar too with a thumb. To begin with select the gnome with the smaller hat. He seems to regularly have the most mushrooms in my experience. Stick with that gnome unless you get bored of him and he has a run of low scores then try the big hat! But always come back to the gnome with the smaller hat. There is no greater score than 9. The lowest you can score is zero. Stay calm when playing. There are no tricks .... just mushrooms !!
